heading: **8 May 2026**
body:
*PNK-treatment of HTFS, NCFS samples*  
\[4 reactions per HTFS sample\]

| DNA | 20 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| T4 PNK Reaction Buffer (10X) | 5 µl |
| ATP (10 mM) | 5 uL |
| [T4 PNK](https://www.neb.com/en-gb/products/m0201-t4-polynucleotide-kinase) | 2 µl (20 units) |
| Nuclease-free Water | up to 50 µl  |

Incubate 37 C, 40 mins. Deactivate 65 C, 20 mins. Freeze tubes at \-20 C.

***Ligation of HTFS, NCFS samples***

2X each for the HTFS samples & 1X reaction for each NCFS sample

| HTFS/NCFS | 4 uL |
| :---- | :---- |
| 50% PEG8000 | 3 uL |
| CoHex 10 mM | 1 uL |
| T4 Ligase Buffer 10X | 1 uL |
| T4 DNA ligase | 1 uL |
title: PNK-treatment of HTFS, NCFS samples
